messages:
Emma T: Quick check — RCA actions for INC-742. Can owners confirm status and whether anything needs to be reprioritized?

Sandeep: I own the DB migration rollback item. Status: blocked by infra access to prod replica snapshots. Filed a support ticket yesterday (SUP-981). ETA depends on snapshot restore window.

Maria L: I have the logging/alerting action. Done on my side, pushed config to staging. Waiting on canary validation from eng-sre.

Jayden: I'm owner for the canary plan + PR. PR is open: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/452 — needs one more review (Cheng?) and a test run.

Cheng: On it, will review this afternoon. Quick note: the PR touches the rollout script; pls don't merge until we confirm the rollback hooks. :exclamation:

Olivia: I'm tracking customer comms and SLA patch. Draft ready, holding until we have final commit window. If DB rollback slides past EOD, I'll send interim note.

Sandeep: @Cheng any chance to accelerate review? Snapshot restore slot is booked for 02:00 UTC tomorrow. If PR isn't merged + canary passes by then, we'll need to postpone the slot.

Cheng: I can prioritize the review now. Tagging a couple quick questions in the PR.

deploy-bot: build #1842 succeeded for branch inc-742/fix-rollback (artifact: infra-rollback-2024-06-05.tar.gz) :white_check_mark:

Maria L: Canary validation checklist (short):
- smoke logs enabled
- error rate < 0.5% for 30m
- latency within SLA%
Please reply with pass/fail so I can promote.

Jayden: Ran canary for 15m — looks good, error rate 0.2% but one spike at 12:16 (stack attached in PR). I haven't promoted to prod yet.

Sandeep: Ok we're aligned: Cheng will finish review in next 45m, Jayden will re-run canary for 30m, Maria will validate metrics. If all green, we target restore window 02:00 UTC.

Olivia: Noted. I'll prep the interim customer note now and hold final send until you confirm.

Cheng: Review comments pushed, small nit and one blocking test. I can help fix the test with Jayden if needed.

Jayden: Thanks — pairing now. Will update PR and start 30m canary at 01:15 UTC to finish before the restore slot.

Emma T: Thanks everyone. Action items recap: [Sandeep] unblock SUP-981 & coordinate snapshot; [Cheng] merge PR + fix tests; [Jayden] run 30m canary and signal; [Maria L] validate metrics; [Olivia] prepare customer comms. Please drop "done" in thread when complete. I'll ping again 00:45 UTC to confirm roll/no-roll. :thumbsup:
